name: clera
description: Hire from Codex: search 210,000+ vetted startup candidates, review Clera's picks, and request intros through the Clera MCP.

interface.longDescription: Clera connects startups with vetted candidates who are open to opportunities. Hiring teams search the candidate pool against a role, review the candidates Clera picked, request introductions and track their pipeline. Candidates search Clera's roles, update preferences and follow their applications.
